facts_and_goals: My employer offers a two-week project rotation in an area I want to learn. My manager approved it, my pay and hours stay the same, and I can return to my role afterward. I have no deadlines during those weeks. I want to explore this skill before considering a career change.
option_b: stay on my usual work during those weeks

relevant_considerations.text: The rotation is reversible with no pay or hours change.
It directly tests a stated career interest.
Clarify expectations and support during the rotation.

facts_and_goals: I have an exam in two days and have not reviewed several core topics. I was invited to a full-day optional campus event tomorrow. There will be another event next month. I want to prepare responsibly and still have a social life.
option_b: skip this event and prioritize review

relevant_considerations.text: The exam is soon and preparation is incomplete.
There is a later opportunity for the event.
A shorter break or partial attendance could be considered.

facts_and_goals: My roommate has missed their share of a utility bill twice. I covered it both times and they said they forgot. We have not set a payment reminder. I want a fair arrangement and a respectful living situation.
option_a: discuss a payment reminder and repayment plan
option_b: keep covering the bills without raising it

relevant_considerations.text: There is a repeated financial imbalance.
A reminder may address forgetting without assigning motives.

facts_and_goals: A discounted annual subscription bundle includes six services, but I use only one of them occasionally. I already have a cheaper monthly option that I can cancel. I want to reduce recurring expenses and am mainly tempted because the discount ends tonight.
option_b: keep the monthly option for now

relevant_considerations.text: The unused services reduce the value of the bundle.
Annual commitment conflicts with flexibility and cost reduction.
A deadline is not evidence of personal need.

facts_and_goals: I have an offer with more interesting tasks and a longer commute. Pay and weekly hours are the same as my current role. I like my current colleagues but want to learn new skills. I have not tried the commute at rush hour or met the new team.

relevant_considerations.text: Learning opportunities and commute are a genuine tradeoff.
Test the commute and learn about the team.
The stated priorities do not settle the decision by themselves.

facts_and_goals: I can take the same elective online or in person. Online would save travel time; in person would give more direct discussion. Both fit my schedule and cost the same. I have done well in both formats and want to learn the material thoroughly.

relevant_considerations.text: Both formats are feasible and similarly priced.
Travel time and direct discussion are different benefits.
Check how discussion and feedback work in each section.
